caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica eventually brings you to the ridges where the gravel ends and the grass begins. Up here, the air is cooler, the climbs are measured in patience, and the horizon stretches all the way to the clouds. These high-altitude farm tracks weren't designed for gears; they follow the natural spine of the hills, demanding everything from your legs and giving back views that make you forget the burn. It is a slow, quiet rhythm—just the sound of tires on damp earth and the steady work of your own lungs. Which climbs make the effort completely disappear for you?
